page: Microsoft Azure D32ns_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine within the Dnv6 series, designated for network optimization and capable of attaching premium storage. The instance operates on the x86_64 architecture and is driven by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor operating at 4.2 GHz. The hardware layout assigns 32 vCPUs across 16 dedicated physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. System memory totals 128 GB, maintaining a balanced 1:4 core-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The processor configuration is augmented by a 260 MB L3 cache and supports instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel AMX matrix extensions.

The instance does not provision local ephemeral storage and contains no discrete GPU accelerators. System disks and application volumes must be connected remotely via compatible network-attached storage architectures. Virtualization is managed under Microsoft Hyper-V, ensuring isolated allocation of compute resources without shared-core throttling.

Performance benchmarks establish high throughput in memory and static data handling. Uncached large-block read bandwidth reaches 210.27 GB/sec, while uncached write bandwidth reaches 92.5 GB/sec, placing memory throughput in the top 25 percent of tested systems. Single-threaded gzip compression achieves 31.42 GB/sec, and static web serving throughput measures 53.75 GB/sec, both scoring in the upper quartile. Standard compute evaluations, including multi-core stress-ng tests and PassMark CPU metrics, reflect middle-tier performance. In machine learning benchmarks, lightweight model text generation achieves top-decile token throughput via hardware vector extensions, whereas larger models exhibit reduced token generation rates.

The D32ns_v6 provides resource-balanced cost efficiency by eliminating expenditures for unneeded local solid-state drives or hardware accelerators while providing elevated network and memory capabilities. The instance profile is aligned with enterprise web serving tiers, microservice orchestration, Redis caching layers, and medium-scale data processing workloads.
description: Microsoft Azure D32ns_v6 is a general-purpose, network-optimized virtual machine instance powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at 4.2 GHz. Configured with 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores and 128 GB of memory, it maintains a standard 4.0 GB per vCPU allocation alongside a 260 MB L3 cache. The server includes no integrated GPUs or local storage disks, relying on external network-attached storage for persistent workloads. In benchmark tests, the instance demonstrates strong uncached memory bandwidth, reaching 210.27 GB/sec for reads, and delivers upper-quartile static web serving throughput. CPU compute metrics and memory cache tests reflect stable middle-tier performance, with enhanced efficiency in vector and matrix-driven tasks via AVX-512 and AMX instruction sets. The D32ns_v6 offers balanced resource utility for enterprise application hosting, web server fleets, distributed caching, and backend API routing.
